data.name: God Sight Road of Ashes
data.detailed_description:
Travel. Survive. Fight. Decide who deserves to stand beside you... in a world where faith can become madness.

A tactical turn-based RPG combined with free-roaming exploration in a dark fantasy world filled with conflict, survival, and difficult choices.

Lead your own caravan across a dangerous land. Explore towns, wilderness, ruins, and forgotten places. Recruit new companions, take on quests, gather resources, and make the choices necessary to keep your people alive.

But combat isn't the only thing you have to worry about.

Food, exhaustion, and stress can gradually wear down your companions. The choices you make can change relationships, shape factions, and determine who becomes an ally — or an enemy.

🗺️ Explore a Hostile World

Lead your caravan and freely travel across a dangerous fantasy world.

Discover towns, villages, ruins, hidden locations, and unexpected events along the way. Take on quests, search for resources, and decide how far you are willing to push your group.

Every journey comes at a cost.

Manage your food supplies, exhaustion, and the mental state of your companions while deciding when to move forward and when to stop and recover.

Sometimes, the safest road isn't the best one.

⚔️ Tactical Turn-Based Combat

When negotiation fails, combat decides the outcome.

Position your companions, choose your targets, use abilities, and take advantage of the battlefield in grid-based tactical combat.

Every character has their own abilities, strengths, and role within the group.

Attack from the flank.
Use high ground to gain an advantage.
Charge into your enemies.
Harness magic and powerful abilities.
Or retreat when the fight is no longer worth the lives it may cost.

Every Action Point matters, and a single mistake can turn the tide of battle.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Build Your Own Band of Travelers

Your party is made up of more than just characters you create yourself.

Hire wandering mercenaries, encounter survivors, and meet characters who can join your group through quests and events.

Each companion has their own abilities, personality, and story.

Someone you save today may become an invaluable member of your party tomorrow.

Or they may have their own reasons for walking away.

🩸 God Sight

There is a cult feared throughout the land.

God Sight.

They believe that humanity can come closer to divine perception by completely shutting away the five senses.

To God Sight, pain is not something to be avoided.

It is a path.

Members of the cult have been found carrying out horrifying rituals. People are taken from their homes, while others willingly submit themselves to the teachings of the faith.

But behind their cruelty lies an even more disturbing question.

Are they truly searching for God — or are they searching for something that was never meant to be found?

⚖️ A World Divided

God Sight is not the only threat.

The world is divided between groups with their own ambitions and beliefs.

  • Villagers and local communities struggling to protect their homes.

  • Soldiers and knights attempting to maintain order.

  • Resistance groups fighting against God Sight.

  • And other factions pursuing their own interests.

As a group of travelers, you don't always have to choose a single side.

Help them.
Deceive them.
Negotiate with them.
Or stay out of their affairs entirely.

The choices you make will determine who you become in this world.

🧠 Survival Is More Than HP

Staying alive isn't simply about keeping your health bar above zero.

Your companions need food.
They need rest.
They suffer from exhaustion.
And they carry the psychological weight of what they experience.

Long battles, losing companions, and traumatic events can affect the mental state of your party.

Because in a world this brutal...

the most dangerous enemy may not be the one standing in front of you, but the one growing inside you.

✦ How Far Will You Take Your Band?

Build your own group of travelers.
Cross a dangerous fantasy world.
Uncover the truth behind God Sight.
Confront competing factions.
And decide for yourself who deserves your help.

Survive the journey.
Fight for what you believe in.
And uncover the truth behind God Sight.

English*, Thai

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or GTX 1060 or better/ AMD R9 290 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 6500, AMD Ryzen 3-1200 or above
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB, AMD RX570 or above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains themes of violence, torture, and death, including severe injuries and mutilation such as dismemberment and eye removal. These themes are connected to the God Sight cult and its rituals, and may be presented through dialogue, story events, and in-game visuals.

The game also contains themes of fear, psychological distress, captivity, coercion, and survival in violent situations. Players may encounter characters who are seriously injured or killed.

The game does not contain explicit sexual content.
